name: Mendesite
purpose: Placeable block with a role in building, automation, crafting, world content, or mod progression.
acquire: Acquire through crafting, stonecutting, loot, worldgen, or creative depending on the block; JEI/EMI is the final recipe source.
use: Place it in-world; press U in JEI/EMI to see recipes, multiblock roles, or crafting uses.

name: Scripting Disk
purpose: Digital storage component that holds items, fluids, chemicals, or autocrafting data inside a storage network.
acquire: Craft or process it with crafting shaped. Press R on the item in JEI/EMI for the exact ATM10 recipe.
use: Press U in JEI/EMI to see every recipe, machine, or crafting use in this ATM10 version.

name: Scripting Drive
purpose: Network block used to access, store, import, export, or automate items inside a storage/crafting system.
acquire: Craft or process it with crafting shaped. Press R on the item in JEI/EMI for the exact ATM10 recipe.
use: Place it, provide required power/items/fluids, configure sides if available, and use JEI/EMI recipes to feed it.
